scope: Legacy WHMCS features, cloud control plane, connector, mobile and public launch. Code and baseline test references are inventory, not proof of production acceptance.

accounts.label: Accounts, sign-in and team access
accounts.summary: Identity and permissions across organizations, brands and operator accounts.

capabilities.label: Signup and organization creation
capabilities.current: Signup creates an owner and workspace; the launch gate currently prevents public registration.
acceptance: Create one owner/workspace; reject duplicate emails and invalid passwords.
A forged operator flag must not create a super admin; a closed release must reject direct POST requests.

capabilities.label: Email verification and resend
capabilities.current: Signed verification routes and resend throttles exist; production delivery is unverified.
acceptance: Deliver a real verification email; expired or altered links must fail.
Unverified users cannot access brand data, billing or downloads.

capabilities.label: Separate customer and operator sign-in
capabilities.current: Customer /login and operator /command/login have separate entry points and throttling.
acceptance: Test valid/invalid login, session regeneration and intended redirects.
Customer accounts must not enter Command Station.

capabilities.label: Password reset and logout
capabilities.current: Reset and logout handlers exist; real reset-email delivery remains unverified.
acceptance: Reset links must expire and work once; reject changed tokens.
Logout invalidates the session and CSRF token.

capabilities.label: Organization roles and staff seats
capabilities.current: Owner, admin, billing and member roles exist; team management adds existing accounts.
acceptance: Exercise each role against reads and writes, including direct routes.
Enforce seat limits, protect the last owner and avoid duplicate memberships.

capabilities.label: Brand viewer and operator access
capabilities.current: Members can be restricted to selected brands as viewer or operator.
acceptance: Viewers cannot run inference or change settings; removing a grant immediately denies access.
Cross-brand IDs must not reveal records, wallet data or results.

capabilities.label: Organization switching
capabilities.current: Dashboard switching requires an existing membership.
acceptance: Switch between two workspaces without leaking brands or usage.
Reject guessed organization IDs and retain a valid session context.

capabilities.label: Operator testing workspace
capabilities.current: Operators can create their own workspace; duplicate submissions reuse it and no credits are automatically granted.
acceptance: Repeat creation and confirm one organization, one owner membership and zero initial credits.

capabilities.label: Staff invitation and acceptance emails
capabilities.current: A complete invitation lifecycle is not implemented; the current team flow requires an existing account.
acceptance: Invite, resend, expire, revoke and accept with the intended email.
Prevent reuse, role escalation and seat-limit bypass.

brands.label: Brands, domains and connector enrollment
brands.summary: Bind each WHMCS installation to its own verified brand.

capabilities.label: Create and update brands
capabilities.current: Brand name, HTTPS WHMCS URL, credit mode, budget, suspension and retention settings exist.
acceptance: Validate URL and plan limits; reject cross-organization writes.
Prevent budget reductions below used plus reserved credits.

capabilities.label: Domain ownership verification
capabilities.current: DNS TXT challenge verification exists; real staging-domain acceptance is still needed.
acceptance: Verify the exact hostname, including a WHMCS subdirectory.
Wrong, missing or stale TXT values cannot mark ownership verified.

capabilities.label: Separate operational database per brand
capabilities.current: A console-only provisioner creates a distinct PostgreSQL database/login; signup does not provision automatically.
acceptance: Provision twice and resume an interrupted attempt without duplicate credentials.
Brand A credentials cannot connect to brand B; web workers cannot provision databases.

capabilities.label: One-time connector enrollment
capabilities.current: A short-lived token binds a connector-generated secret to a verified WHMCS URL.
acceptance: Enroll on staging; reject expired tokens and URL mismatch.
Retry a lost response with the same secret without creating another installation.

capabilities.label: Signed requests and replay protection
capabilities.current: HMAC, timestamps, nonce replay protection and body limits guard installation APIs.
acceptance: Reject altered body/path, stale timestamps, reused nonces and oversized requests.
Confirm TLS validation, DNS pinning and redirect blocking on the deployed network.

capabilities.label: Replace, revoke and suspend installations
capabilities.current: Replacing enrollment revokes old credentials; brand/organization suspension blocks cloud work.
acceptance: Old credentials fail after replacement or revocation, including queued work before dispatch.
Sahdev suspension must not suspend customer hosting services.

capabilities.label: WHMCS identity, role and department checks
capabilities.current: The connector checks active admin, addon role, native ticket permission, department and CSRF.
acceptance: Test full, restricted and disabled admins on real WHMCS.
Remove access during polling and confirm result access is denied.

capabilities.label: Connection health and version diagnostics
capabilities.current: The connector can confirm its signed connection, preview availability, provisioning and priced model count. Full version and clock-skew diagnostics remain open.
acceptance: Diagnose expired enrollment, clock drift, offline cloud and incompatible versions.
Health checks must not start paid work or reveal installation secrets.

credits.label: Credits, budgets and usage accounting
credits.summary: Integer accounting, scoped balances and predictable request charging.

capabilities.label: Shared organization credit pool
capabilities.current: Pooled brands use the organization wallet subject to their own monthly caps.
acceptance: Run two brands against the last available credits concurrently.
Combined holds and charges must not overspend the pool.

capabilities.label: Brand allocation and credit transfers
capabilities.current: Allocated brands use their own wallet; transfers produce matching ledger movements.
acceptance: Transfer both directions and replay the request key.
Credits are conserved and allocated brands cannot implicitly spend the shared pool.

capabilities.label: Monthly budgets and UTC periods
capabilities.current: Holds count toward the UTC month in which a request was accepted.
acceptance: Cross a month boundary with an outstanding request and settle in the original period.
Enforce exhausted budgets and prevent lowering below spent plus reserved amounts.

capabilities.label: Reserve, dispatch, settle and release
capabilities.current: Work reserves credits first; known usage settles once and confirmed rejection releases holds.
acceptance: Inject a failure at every transition and restart the worker.
Debit, ledger and state commit together; no duplicate paid dispatch.

capabilities.label: Unknown outcomes and reconciliation
capabilities.current: Unconfirmed provider outcomes preserve holds for operator review.
acceptance: Timeout after acceptance, then reconcile confirmed usage or no-charge evidence.
Keep one final ledger movement and the provider request reference.

capabilities.label: Immutable price versions and microcredits
capabilities.current: Reservations snapshot pricing and use integer microcredits.
acceptance: Change rates while work is queued; the original price still applies.
Test rounding, zero usage, cached input and usage exceeding the reservation.

capabilities.label: Model, concurrency and spending limits
capabilities.current: Plan entitlements and concurrency limits are checked before reserve and dispatch.
acceptance: Revoke model access or suspend a brand while work is queued.
Denied work makes no provider call and releases its hold safely.

capabilities.label: Usage history and accounting invariants
capabilities.current: Dashboard history and reconciliation commands expose wallet movements.
acceptance: Reconcile all balances, holds, transfers, charges and reversals after concurrent work.
Archived models or plans must not erase financial history.

ai_gateway.label: AI providers, models and routing
ai_gateway.summary: Operator-managed credentials, protocols, model capabilities and costs.

capabilities.label: Custom provider CRUD and credentials
capabilities.current: Operators can configure public HTTPS providers; keys are encrypted and not returned in forms.
acceptance: Create, update, disable and archive; an unchanged key remains intact.
Reject private/mixed DNS, redirects, invalid protocols and unsafe URLs; redact credentials.

capabilities.label: Model IDs, limits, prices and plan assignment
capabilities.current: Model identifiers, token parameters, capability flags and rates are separate model records.
acceptance: Test gpt-5-nano, owner/model and custom identifiers.
Require active provider, valid pricing, compatible token parameter and explicit plan entitlement.

capabilities.label: OpenAI-compatible text and tool calls
capabilities.current: Chat Completions compatible providers, including custom hosts, are supported.
acceptance: Validate a real permitted model with text and supported tools.
Handle invalid keys, quota, rate limiting, malformed output and missing usage without paid retries.

capabilities.label: Anthropic Messages protocol
capabilities.current: Messages requests and response normalization exist.
acceptance: Validate a real Messages model, usage counts and stop reasons.
Reject malformed content and unsupported tool shapes without claiming success.

capabilities.label: Replicate text predictions and polling
capabilities.current: One prediction POST is followed by same-host polling; supported text models must report token counts.
acceptance: Test queued, processing, succeeded, failed, canceled and timed-out predictions.
Never follow a supplied polling URL or submit twice; unsupported schemas stay unavailable.

capabilities.label: Live provider and model acceptance
capabilities.current: Automated contracts exist; deployed requests using configured credentials still need evidence.
acceptance: Use a small non-customer prompt for every published model/protocol.
Compare provider usage with the Sahdev charge and record model, request reference and date.

capabilities.label: Per-feature model routing and fallback rules
capabilities.current: Legacy task-specific routes exist; SaaS does not yet provide full per-feature routing parity.
acceptance: Configure tickets, summary, chat, Copilot, reconnaissance and cron independently.
Uncertain usage must not trigger a second model or fallback charge.

capabilities.label: Model discovery, presets and test UI
capabilities.current: Legacy presets and fetch-live-model controls are not migrated into the cloud catalog.
acceptance: List supported models without revealing keys and preserve manual custom IDs.
Distinguish unsupported discovery, invalid credentials and lack of model access.

billing.label: Credit purchases, invoices and payment recovery
billing.summary: HostingSpell WHMCS owns tax invoices and gateway processing.

capabilities.label: Prepaid packs and brand attribution
capabilities.current: Credit quantities and currency prices are independent; purchases fund the pool with optional brand attribution.
acceptance: Confirm price, credits, currency and attribution before order creation.
Repricing/archiving must not change existing orders; packs are not recurring subscriptions.

capabilities.label: Promotion expiry and redemption limits
capabilities.current: Discount, redemption cap, expiry and availability are configurable.
acceptance: Reject expired, disabled or exhausted codes under concurrency.
An order retry cannot consume another redemption.

capabilities.label: Verified WHMCS billing-client mapping
capabilities.current: Operators link organization to a HostingSpell client ID; automatic identity onboarding is incomplete.
acceptance: Verify the payer before mapping; block cross-customer invoice access.
Existing invoice history protects mapping changes.

capabilities.label: Invoice creation and uncertain-result recovery
capabilities.current: Async invoice creation sends ambiguous outcomes to review rather than creating another invoice.
acceptance: Timeout after creation, attach the existing verified invoice and retry the order.
Confirm one order, one invoice and preserved price/tax context.

capabilities.label: Razorpay, PayPal and Stripe acceptance
capabilities.current: Gateways are delegated to HostingSpell WHMCS; live payment acceptance is unrecorded.
acceptance: Validate totals, taxes, currency, redirect and confirmation with configured gateways.
Canceled/failed payments grant no credits; payment credentials stay with billing.

capabilities.label: Signed events and missed-payment reconciliation
capabilities.current: Signatures, replay protection and invoice identity verification guard credit issuance.
acceptance: Deliver duplicate/out-of-order events and reconcile a missed paid event.
Wrong customer, unpaid invoice, tampered body or stale signature never grants credits.

capabilities.label: Refunds, reversals and chargebacks
capabilities.current: Full reversal and review states exist; partial refunds need a separate policy.
acceptance: Reverse unused and already-spent credits without deleting history or enabling negative spending.
Require evidence for full reversal and define partial-refund treatment before sales.

command_station.label: Command Station and operator controls
command_station.summary: Operator changes and exception resolution remain auditable.

capabilities.label: Catalog create, update, disable and archive
capabilities.current: Operators manage providers, models, plans, packs and promotions while retaining history.
acceptance: Exercise CRUD and validation for every catalog type.
Retain non-secret input after errors and never flash a provider key.

capabilities.label: Organization plans, limits and suspension
capabilities.current: Operators assign plans, link billing, suspend workspaces and inspect brand usage.
acceptance: Test plan reductions and suspension with pending work.
Record actor, reason and before/after state.

capabilities.label: Promotional and correction credit grants
capabilities.current: Grants have an idempotency key, reason and ledger/audit entries.
acceptance: Replay a grant and confirm one credit.
Only operators can grant; invalid or negative amounts fail.

capabilities.label: Enable or disable operator MFA
capabilities.current: Super-admin settings control optional MFA; the chosen setting remains authoritative.
acceptance: Require current password for setting changes and test verification expiry.
Validate TOTP replay protection and confirm disabling MFA cannot elevate a customer.

capabilities.label: Usage and billing exception review
capabilities.current: Uncertain usage, provider references and credit orders are available for review.
acceptance: Resolve confirmed outcomes without duplicate charge/refund.
Preserve operator identity, evidence, request reference and timestamps.

capabilities.label: Audit trail, errors and queue visibility
capabilities.current: Application audit log and queue counters exist; external protected logging and alert delivery need acceptance.
acceptance: Check actor, target, before/after state and secret redaction.
Failed jobs and stale holds must alert the responsible operator.

capabilities.label: Delegated support and finance operator roles
capabilities.current: The platform currently uses one trusted operator flag, not distinct operator permission sets.
acceptance: Define support, finance and infrastructure roles and deny unauthorized direct routes.
Support operators cannot edit pricing or provider keys without explicit grants.

ticket_ai.label: Ticket analysis, replies and editor workflow
ticket_ai.summary: Five cloud draft workflows exist; complete standard ticket-workspace parity is pending.

capabilities.label: Root cause, responsibility, risk and action plan
capabilities.current: The cloud returns validated analysis fields and a reviewable client reply.
acceptance: Verify required fields, risk enum and malformed output handling.
Treat ticket text as untrusted and distinguish hypotheses from facts.

capabilities.label: Conversation summaries
capabilities.current: Cloud summaries use bounded public ticket messages.
acceptance: Test chronology, pending questions and long conversations.
Never claim proposed actions were executed or expose private notes.

capabilities.label: Tone-aware draft rewriting
capabilities.current: Cloud rewrite accepts a supplied draft, selected tone and bounded instruction.
acceptance: Reject empty/non-string drafts and preserve facts/commitments.
No automatic sending or invented troubleshooting results.

capabilities.label: Reply quality scoring
capabilities.current: Cloud output validates clarity, tone, completeness, overall score and notes.
acceptance: Reject missing fields and scores outside 0–100.
Evaluate against the supplied thread and flag unsupported claims.

capabilities.label: Reusable canned draft generation
capabilities.current: Cloud returns a title and reusable template; publishing to the library is not included.
acceptance: Replace identifying details with placeholders.
Reject malformed output and require separate permission to save/publish.

capabilities.label: Services, domains, attachments and private notes
capabilities.current: Preview sends the ticket and 20 public replies; richer account and attachment context is not migrated.
acceptance: Allow only scoped sources and safe bounded attachments; block credential fields and path traversal.
Expose truncation and prevent internal notes leaking into client replies.

capabilities.label: Progress, request replay and result access
capabilities.current: Encrypted local journal retains one key after timeouts; cloud results are actor/ticket scoped.
acceptance: Lose the submit response, reload and resume without another charge.
Test queued, released, uncertain, expired and unauthorized results.

capabilities.label: Rich formatting and related-record links
capabilities.current: Markdown and ticket/client links work in the preview; full invoice/service/product context is pending.
acceptance: Render headings, tables, code and lists without scripts or tracking images.
Each related link must use the correct custom admin path and native permissions.

capabilities.label: Editor insertion, signature and concurrent edits
capabilities.current: Legacy TinyMCE/plain-text insertion and signature-safe polishing are not migrated; preview uses Copy draft.
acceptance: Preserve configured signature and staff edits made during a request.
Support TinyMCE/plain textarea without targeting another editor or sending the reply.

capabilities.label: Saved analysis, summaries and customer memory
capabilities.current: Legacy saved-result CRUD, historical context and full cache parity remain local.
acceptance: Reuse unchanged results without new charges; invalidate changed context.
Scope old tickets to the client and preserve content when deletion fails.

capabilities.label: Sentiment, urgency, tone and ticket tags
capabilities.current: Legacy insights and ai-* WHMCS tag integration remain local.
acceptance: Validate enums, score bounds and tag syntax; avoid duplicate unchanged analyses.
Preserve manual tags and distinguish triage from verified evidence.

capabilities.label: Intent, model, depth and evidence controls
capabilities.current: Preview exposes workflow, model, tone and token limit; standard per-admin controls are incomplete.
acceptance: Honor global/personal switches consistently in UI and API.
Hidden controls must not leave unauthorized callable endpoints.

case_timeline.label: Case timeline and historical evidence
case_timeline.summary: Preserve source provenance, staff layouts and bounded historical context.

capabilities.label: Timeline policy CRUD and active-policy selection
capabilities.current: Standard module supports source policies; cloud policy management is not migrated.
acceptance: Create, edit, activate and delete policies while retaining existing settings.
No active policy means no collection; display and AI inclusion are separate switches.

capabilities.label: Scoped hosting, domain, server and message sources
capabilities.current: Legacy collectors restrict context to the ticket client and linked service/domain.
acceptance: Test unrelated clients, unlinked services, missing server data and disabled sources.
Do not read credentials or arbitrary customer records.

capabilities.label: Dated immutable diagnostic snapshots
capabilities.current: Legacy snapshots keep run identity, observation time and structured facts.
acceptance: Capture once per diagnostic run; cached evidence is not a new observation.
Distinguish current configuration, customer reports and measured observations.

capabilities.label: Nine timeline layouts and workspace navigation
capabilities.current: Standard module has timeline, lanes, ledger, split, ribbon, journal, milestones and evidence-to-action layouts.
acceptance: Verify every layout in supported themes and narrow screens.
Keep Analysis, Tools, Summary, KB and Memory controls functional and keyboard accessible.

capabilities.label: Concise highlights and source excerpts
capabilities.current: Legacy interpretation is bounded extractive processing, not an extra model call.
acceptance: Retain source IDs/timestamps and label stale, conflicting or incomplete facts.
Removing signatures/quotes must not alter original WHMCS messages.

capabilities.label: Snapshot inspection, deletion and retention
capabilities.current: Legacy snapshot cleanup and per-ticket deletion are not migrated.
acceptance: Enforce bounded retention, immediate expiry exclusion and cleanup while collection is disabled.
Do not delete underlying ticket messages or unrelated tool history.

capabilities.label: Bounded timeline context in AI generation
capabilities.current: Legacy AI inclusion has a separate switch and byte/event limits.
acceptance: Disable one source or tool evidence and confirm exclusion from the actual request.
Remove whole oldest events within the budget and avoid duplicate presentation fields.

live_chat.label: Customer widget and live staff console
live_chat.summary: Guest/customer identity, human handoff and customer-safe responses.

capabilities.label: Widget opening, embedding and customizer
capabilities.current: The standard widget and design/rules editor remain local; no thin SaaS widget is released.
acceptance: Open/close on WHMCS and external allowed pages; test theme, position, mobile and disabled states.
Fail visibly and safely when the cloud is unavailable.

capabilities.label: Guest visitor and authenticated client identity
capabilities.current: Legacy sessions bind visitor tokens or client identity and control account scope.
acceptance: A guest cannot request a client's private invoices/services.
Login/logout and visitor-email linking must not merge unrelated customers.

capabilities.label: Session creation, history and incremental polling
capabilities.current: Legacy chat supports multiple sessions, history and after-message polling.
acceptance: Create/switch/reload sessions and resume after connection loss.
Deny session-ID guessing and avoid duplicate messages during concurrent sends.

capabilities.label: Customer Markdown, citations and record links
capabilities.current: Legacy customer responses have formatting and record context; cloud migration is pending.
acceptance: Render tables, lists and safe links; no fabricated billing or health answers.
Internal notes, prompts and unrelated records must never enter customer output.

capabilities.label: Client balances, services, invoices and tickets
capabilities.current: Legacy customer-scoped enrichment is available only inside the standard module.
acceptance: Prove every returned record belongs to the authenticated client and permitted source.
Correctly handle no results, multiple currencies and unavailable account data.

capabilities.label: Public products and domain pricing
capabilities.current: Legacy product/domain catalog supplies public sales context.
acceptance: Respect hidden products, current currency and active pricing.
Public visitors see public catalog data only; do not invent stock or availability.

capabilities.label: Guest/client quotas and abuse controls
capabilities.current: Legacy quotas, rate limits, exemptions and input bounds are not migrated.
acceptance: Test guest, customer and human-agent session limits plus concurrent requests.
An exemption must not grant record access or bypass platform budget limits.

capabilities.label: Staff availability, heartbeat and typing preview
capabilities.current: Legacy console has staff presence and visitor sneak-peek.
acceptance: Expire stale presence and reconnect without duplicating staff sessions.
Restrict previews to permitted staff and expose offline handling.

capabilities.label: Human summon, exclusive claim and release
capabilities.current: Legacy summon/claim/release and timeout logic remain local.
acceptance: Two agents claiming a chat must produce one owner; release/resume works.
AI stops while a human owns the session and stale claims expire predictably.

capabilities.label: Staff send, edit, delete and canned shortcuts
capabilities.current: Legacy staff messaging and optional customer notifications are not migrated.
acceptance: Enforce ownership and permissions on send/edit/delete.
Preserve ordering, clear edit/deletion state and avoid duplicate notification delivery.

capabilities.label: Escalate chat into a support ticket
capabilities.current: Legacy guest/client escalation and transcript conversion remain local.
acceptance: Choose permitted department, verify identity and create one linked ticket.
Retry safely; sanitize transcript and exclude private staff-only material.

capabilities.label: CSAT ratings and customer feedback
capabilities.current: Legacy ratings and aggregate CSAT are not migrated.
acceptance: Only an owned message can be rated; duplicate submissions update safely.
Preserve per-brand scope and distinguish no feedback from a zero score.

capabilities.label: Sound, browser alerts and notification ownership
capabilities.current: Legacy console includes alert rules, audio leadership and notification preferences.
acceptance: Test multiple tabs, muted/offline staff, repeat alerts and resolved summons.
One event should not cause an uncontrolled alert loop.

copilot.label: Admin Ops Copilot and related records
copilot.summary: Move conversation orchestration to the cloud while retaining native authorization.

capabilities.label: Floating widget and full Ops Console
capabilities.current: The thin connector has a floating record lookup for authorized admins. Full Ops Console and conversation history still need migration.
acceptance: Open from multiple admin pages and use the full console.
Test missing assets, disabled permission, responsive layout and failed request recovery.

capabilities.label: Admin threads, ownership and history
capabilities.current: Legacy admin sessions and recent threads remain local.
acceptance: Create, switch, refresh and resume threads without cross-admin leakage.
Unauthenticated or forged session references fail.

capabilities.label: Page context and conversational record resolution
capabilities.current: Legacy Copilot accepts bounded page context and resolves related WHMCS records.
acceptance: Resolve a follow-up such as all invoices for this client without changing client scope.
Ambiguous names require disambiguation and guessed browser context is not authority.

capabilities.label: Clients, invoices, services, products and tickets
capabilities.current: The connector searches clients by ID, full name or company, and returns paginated invoice/service tables with native links. Ticket lookup and full parity are pending.
acceptance: List/paginate matching records and provide a separate link for each item.
Enforce resource/field/client rules and handle empty or ambiguous results.

capabilities.label: Tables, links, totals and actionable cards
capabilities.current: Cloud-formatted tables show invoice amounts with currency and related record links. Conversational replies, aggregates and action cards remain pending.
acceptance: Render Markdown safely, preserve related links and show currency-correct totals.
Separate a proposed action from an executed result and avoid raw JSON spam.

capabilities.label: Read-only tools, financial metrics and gateway failures
capabilities.current: Legacy tool registry covers ticket/account lookup, metrics and telemetry.
acceptance: Select only allowed tools and report tool failures as failures.
Metrics, gateway logs and server views require their own permissions.

capabilities.label: Proposal cards, approval status and rollback journal
capabilities.current: Legacy proposal/journal views exist; cloud planning and connector execution are not migrated.
acceptance: Expose complete target, before/after values, created/deleted records, impact and rollback limits.
Approval, execution and rollback remain separate authenticated actions.

capabilities.label: Progress, cancellation and uncertain outcomes
capabilities.current: Legacy streaming/admin message handling remains local.
acceptance: Test interrupted output, reconnect and a late tool result.
Never execute again because the browser lost its response.

safe_operations.label: Database ACL, approvals and atomic rollback
safe_operations.summary: Typed, allowlisted WHMCS operations; no unrestricted remote SQL.

capabilities.label: Enablement and explicit per-role grants
capabilities.current: Legacy database access is disabled by default; even full admins need explicit resource grants.
acceptance: Test disabled access, missing role, disabled admin and permission revocation.
Cloud prompts and a super-admin role cannot expand the database allowlist.

capabilities.label: Field, operation, value and client-scope constraints
capabilities.current: Legacy policy intersects read/write fields, allowed operations/values and client filters.
acceptance: Reject forbidden fields, wildcard resources, invalid values and out-of-scope clients.
Verify limits on returned rows, predicates and mutations.

capabilities.label: Typed SELECT and relational lookup
capabilities.current: Legacy queries use allowlisted resources and bounded filters, not arbitrary model SQL.
acceptance: Exercise each resource in the database matrix with permitted and forbidden predicates.
Return only authorized fields and preserve ticket-note ownership joins.

capabilities.label: Full before/after action plan
capabilities.current: Legacy planner snapshots target rows and produces immutable proposals.
acceptance: Show every record and field affected, create/delete semantics, risk and expiry.
Persist a plan digest and prevent the browser or model from replacing the approved payload.

capabilities.label: Approval, reauthentication and policy recheck
capabilities.current: Legacy approval validates the actor, session and current authorization.
acceptance: Test expired/cross-session plans, incorrect password and a role revoked after preview.
Recheck rules and record state immediately before execution.

capabilities.label: Atomic database execution and failure rollback
capabilities.current: Legacy operations check transactional storage and use one local database transaction.
acceptance: Inject failure after the first of multiple writes and confirm no partial business changes.
Reject nontransactional tables, stale snapshots and changed schema.

capabilities.label: Create/update/delete lifecycle and generated IDs
capabilities.current: Legacy typed CRUD covers permitted notes and updates, not blanket CRUD on all core tables.
acceptance: Record inserted IDs, complete delete snapshots and exact update differences.
Protect relations and reject unsupported resource/operation combinations.

capabilities.label: Client balance plus credit-ledger consistency
capabilities.current: Legacy credit adjustment updates balance and ledger together with compensation rules.
acceptance: Inject failure between balance and ledger writes; both must roll back.
Reversal must not erase audit evidence or combine currencies.

capabilities.label: Conflict-safe reversal after committed changes
capabilities.current: Legacy rollback compares current state to the original after-state and restores permitted snapshots.
acceptance: Execute then roll back create/update/delete cases on real MySQL/MariaDB.
Refuse rollback if another actor changed the affected state; repeat rollback safely.

capabilities.label: Operation journal, failure evidence and audit history
capabilities.current: Legacy plan, execution, failure and rollback events are retained locally.
acceptance: Trace request to plan, approving admin, affected rows, execution and rollback.
Failed execution must leave useful redacted evidence without a partial mutation.

capabilities.label: Boundaries for email, payment and provisioning effects
capabilities.current: Atomic database rollback cannot undo external gateway, mail or server actions; SaaS contracts are not migrated.
acceptance: Classify each operation as local transaction, compensating action or irreversible effect before approval.
Never describe a service module call, sent email or captured payment as atomically reversible.

knowledge.label: Knowledge, canned replies and content sources
knowledge.summary: Retrieval and prompt methodology move to the cloud; customers get scoped results.

capabilities.label: Knowledge articles, search and editor insertion
capabilities.current: Legacy KB management, search, previews and insertion are not migrated.
acceptance: Create/update/delete/search articles; handle canceled or failed searches.
Preview before insertion and respect customer/staff visibility.

capabilities.label: Canned response CRUD, categories and shortcuts
capabilities.current: Legacy canned templates and keyboard shortcuts remain local.
acceptance: Create, edit, delete and search with unique shortcuts and safe placeholders.
Separate draft generation from publishing and restrict library edits.

capabilities.label: RAG, runbooks and predefined response retrieval
capabilities.current: Legacy relevance search reads KB, canned replies and runbook sources.
acceptance: Retrieve only brand-permitted sources and cite useful evidence.
Treat retrieved text as untrusted; no-result cases must not invent knowledge.

capabilities.label: Website source CRUD, sync and structured data
capabilities.current: Legacy website data sources support source control and remote sync.
acceptance: Create/update/disable/delete and sync supported formats.
Reject unsafe destinations, oversized responses and stale failed syncs without replacing valid content silently.

capabilities.label: Cloud-owned prompts, personas and task templates
capabilities.current: Five preview workflow prompts are server-owned; the complete Prompt Manager migration is pending.
acceptance: Version each template and preserve explicitly supported brand customizations.
Never distribute proprietary templates or let custom instructions grant executable permissions.

capabilities.label: Intent matching and action configuration
capabilities.current: Legacy intent keywords/directives and task actions remain local.
acceptance: Resolve matching/overlapping intents with bounded allowed actions.
Disabling an intent must stop it in background and interactive flows.

capabilities.label: Indexing, freshness and source deletion
capabilities.current: A unified cloud indexing, invalidation and deletion pipeline is not implemented.
acceptance: Update/remove a source and confirm future retrieval stops serving old content.
Preserve required audit evidence while respecting retention and tenant boundaries.

automation.label: Ticket Autopilot, cron and scheduled work
automation.summary: Policy-driven background work with duplicate prevention and operator visibility.

capabilities.label: Autopilot eligibility and exclusion rules
capabilities.current: Legacy department, status, keyword and first-reply rules are not migrated.
acceptance: Test eligible, blocked and already-replied tickets with the effective policy.
Recheck eligibility after a queued delay and before a write.

capabilities.label: Autopilot draft versus send behavior
capabilities.current: Legacy auto-draft, internal-note and reply modes remain local.
acceptance: A preview/draft mode cannot send to a customer.
Sending requires explicit policy, native permission, correct signature and an audit record.

capabilities.label: Duplicate prevention and staff-reply races
capabilities.current: Legacy attempt tracking and ticket state checks require cloud parity.
acceptance: Run concurrent workers and let a staff member reply while AI is generating.
Produce at most one intended automated reply and retain the newer staff action.

capabilities.label: Insights queue, batch triage and retry controls
capabilities.current: Legacy sentiment/urgency/tags queue and progress controls remain local.
acceptance: Process bounded batches, skip unchanged contexts and report failed tickets.
Resume safely after timeout without repeating paid analysis unnecessarily.

capabilities.label: Cron schedules, authentication and run status
capabilities.current: Standard Cron Center and WHMCS hooks are not migrated into a per-brand SaaS scheduler.
acceptance: Test protected cron invocation, missed runs, overlapping runs and last-success visibility.
One brand cannot schedule work against another brand.

capabilities.label: Emergency pause and per-feature/provider controls
capabilities.current: Legacy automation switches and task-specific model routes remain local.
acceptance: Pause during queued work and confirm no newly prohibited work dispatches.
Resume without replaying completed side effects.

capabilities.label: Automated tags, staff notes and notifications
capabilities.current: Legacy post-processing includes optional tags, notes and alerts.
acceptance: Apply allowed side effects once and preserve manual content.
Notification failure must not cause the underlying ticket mutation to repeat.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics, tools and technical evidence
diagnostics.summary: Bounded approved tools, truthful observations and source provenance.

capabilities.label: Issue routing and follow-up target recovery
capabilities.current: Legacy routes DNS, web, mail, SSL, performance and related diagnostics.
acceptance: Test subdomains, URL paths, email-domain extraction and explicit record types.
Recover context only from the authorized conversation; do not use assistant-invented targets.

capabilities.label: Local recipes and optional AI reconnaissance
capabilities.current: Legacy diagnostics can use bounded local recipes or a planner.
acceptance: Enforce category/tool allowlists, argument schemas and maximum checks.
Planner failure cannot suppress a valid basic diagnostic recipe or expand permissions.

capabilities.label: Manual ToolsAPI operations and parameters
capabilities.current: Legacy tools use an OpenAPI operation registry and explicit admin parameters.
acceptance: Validate methods, endpoints, required parameters and conflicting arguments.
Disabled tools must be blocked in both automatic and manual paths.

capabilities.label: Destination and outbound network protection
capabilities.current: Legacy preflight checks exist; final remote resolution belongs to ToolsAPI.
acceptance: Verify final DNS resolution and every redirect reject internal/link-local destinations.
Exercise IPv4/IPv6, DNS changes and credential-bearing URLs on the deployed tool service.

capabilities.label: Deadlines, locks, bounded responses and retries
capabilities.current: Legacy executor uses deadlines, advisory locks, response caps and scoped caching.
acceptance: Run parallel turns and force upstream timeout/schema errors.
Release locks and preserve failure state; never cache an error as a healthy result.

capabilities.label: DNS, SSL, ping, WHOIS, mail and performance evidence
capabilities.current: Legacy normalizers retain structured facts and failed-check states.
acceptance: Compare fixtures and real tool responses, including partial/missing facts.
Keep upstream observation times and distinguish cached evidence from a fresh measurement.

capabilities.label: Service matching and optional telemetry enrichment
capabilities.current: Legacy diagnostics match only services/domains owned by the ticket/chat client.
acceptance: Test shared IPs, unrelated accounts and disabled enrichment.
Configuration context must not be described as live server health.

capabilities.label: Channel switches and emergency stop
capabilities.current: Legacy policies separately control tickets, chat, automatic/manual tools and emergency stop.
acceptance: Test every switch in UI and API, including work already queued.
Merely selecting a planner/model cannot enable execution.

capabilities.label: Diagnostic trace, retention and cleanup
capabilities.current: Legacy redacted trace events and bounded cleanup remain local.
acceptance: Record route, outcome, HTTP status and elapsed time without raw secrets/messages.
Cleanup works with logging disabled and preserves unrelated module logs.

telemetry.label: Server health and incident response
telemetry.summary: Server observations, outage clusters and controlled customer communication.

capabilities.label: Server polling, role detection and health snapshots
capabilities.current: Standard server polling and role/port detection remain local.
acceptance: Poll supported configured server types, including timeout/auth failures.
Timestamp and expire observations; do not present stale or failed reads as healthy.

capabilities.label: Account disk, resource and daemon visibility
capabilities.current: Legacy account/server summaries use the linked service/server.
acceptance: Prove client/service scope and dedicated telemetry permissions.
Missing account metrics must be labeled unavailable, not zero usage.

capabilities.label: WHM and service control-panel SSO
capabilities.current: Legacy server and mobile service SSO are not migrated.
acceptance: Validate native permissions and service/server ownership before issuing a link.
Do not leak access tokens into logs, history or unrelated users.

capabilities.label: Outage clusters and incident status
capabilities.current: Legacy incident detection groups related tickets and surfaces active incidents.
acceptance: Validate clustering against time, server and service identity; resolve/reopen incidents.
A generic repeated symptom must not be promoted to a confirmed outage without evidence.

capabilities.label: Incident broadcast replies and client alerts
capabilities.current: Legacy incident UI can coordinate replies; cloud approval and delivery are pending.
acceptance: Preview affected tickets/clients and exact message before sending.
Handle partial delivery, duplicates and retries without implying messages can be atomically unsent.

capabilities.label: Header status and client service health cards
capabilities.current: Legacy widgets show outages and account health in WHMCS.
acceptance: Test refresh, no-data, permission-denied and mobile states.
Widget failures must not break the host WHMCS page.

analytics.label: Business metrics and reporting
analytics.summary: Hosting business metrics and SaaS usage reporting must retain brand, currency and time boundaries.

capabilities.label: MRR, ARR and revenue trends
capabilities.current: Hosting revenue calculations remain in the legacy module.
acceptance: Reconcile sampled invoices and recurring services with WHMCS.
Separate currencies, refunds, one-time charges and reporting periods.

capabilities.label: Client growth, churn and invoice aging
capabilities.current: Client and receivables metrics have not migrated.
acceptance: Verify active/new/churned definitions and overdue buckets against a fixed dataset.

capabilities.label: Payment success and gateway failures
capabilities.current: Gateway reporting remains local.
acceptance: Match failed and successful transactions without exposing gateway credentials or raw payment payloads.

capabilities.label: Support velocity and staff performance
capabilities.current: Ticket and support reporting remains local.
acceptance: Verify response-time boundaries, staff attribution and department permissions.

capabilities.label: Product and service revenue
capabilities.current: Product revenue breakdown remains local.
acceptance: Follow a product aggregate to authorized services and invoices with consistent totals.

capabilities.label: Trends and anomaly detection
capabilities.current: Metric aggregation and anomaly logic have not moved to SaaS.
acceptance: Re-run an aggregation without duplicates; distinguish missing data from zero activity.

capabilities.label: Brand and organization AI usage
capabilities.current: SaaS shows wallet and request activity; full cost and margin analytics are incomplete.
acceptance: Reconcile tokens, charged credits and provider costs for each brand.
Include pending and uncertain requests without counting them as settled spend.

capabilities.label: Report exports and scheduled delivery
capabilities.current: Tenant-safe exports and scheduled reports need implementation.
acceptance: Apply the same scope to screen and export; redact personal data and limit large exports.

mobile.label: Sahdev Mobile
mobile.summary: The Flutter client and legacy mobile API need a cloud authentication and authorization migration before distribution.

capabilities.label: Login, QR pairing and session expiry
capabilities.current: Mobile authenticates against the legacy WHMCS API.
acceptance: Pair one device to one brand; expire QR codes and sessions; reject reused pairing tokens.

capabilities.label: Device inventory and revocation
capabilities.current: Device and token management remains local.
acceptance: List devices by brand and revoke one without affecting others; revoked requests fail immediately.

capabilities.label: Live queue, history and staff takeover
capabilities.current: Queue and live-chat actions depend on the legacy API.
acceptance: Read the queue, claim a conversation, reply and release; handle offline retries without duplicate messages.

capabilities.label: Ticket list, replies, notes and status
capabilities.current: Ticket operations and AI analysis are not cloud migrated.
acceptance: Open a ticket, add a private note and reply with correct visibility; enforce department access on every action.

capabilities.label: Client profiles and notes
capabilities.current: Client search, details and note actions are legacy APIs.
acceptance: Link profile, invoices and services; prevent cross-brand lookups; audit note writes.

capabilities.label: Services, status changes and control-panel SSO
capabilities.current: Service actions remain on the legacy mobile endpoint.
acceptance: Scope SSO and status updates to authorized services; disclose external effects before approval.

capabilities.label: Invoice details and payment actions
capabilities.current: Invoice viewing and mark-paid actions remain local.
acceptance: Open an invoice and validate currency; require explicit permission and an auditable action plan for payment changes.

capabilities.label: Canned-response management
capabilities.current: Canned response CRUD still depends on local APIs.
acceptance: Respect staff permissions for create, edit, delete and use in a reply.

capabilities.label: FCM registration and notification routing
capabilities.current: Push and background event handling have not migrated.
acceptance: Register and revoke devices; open the correct brand and record from a push; omit sensitive content from notifications.

capabilities.label: Signed APK, updates and device compatibility
capabilities.current: No accepted SaaS-connected mobile release is published.
acceptance: Verify release signing, upgrade preservation, supported Android versions and recovery from an unavailable API.

preferences.label: Settings, preferences and help
preferences.summary: Preserve personal preferences while moving organization policy and proprietary logic into the cloud.

capabilities.label: Global feature and department controls
capabilities.current: Legacy settings are not yet managed through the cloud.
acceptance: Document defaults and precedence; disabled features must reject direct calls as well as hide UI.

capabilities.label: Personal model, tone and analysis depth
capabilities.current: Personal ticket-assistant preferences remain local.
acceptance: Persist per staff member; respect administrator model restrictions and organization budgets.

capabilities.label: Themes, spacing and accessibility
capabilities.current: Legacy themes and UI preferences need connector compatibility.
acceptance: Verify keyboard navigation, contrast, reduced motion, small screens and persisted theme choices.

capabilities.label: Sound and notification preferences
capabilities.current: Alert preferences remain in legacy web/mobile flows.
acceptance: Respect mute and focus settings; avoid repeated alerts for one event.

capabilities.label: Help, glossary and version information
capabilities.current: Cloud installation guidance exists; full feature help is not migrated.
acceptance: Every enabled feature needs accurate instructions, permission requirements and an actionable error path.

capabilities.label: Settings import and safe defaults
capabilities.current: No accepted migration exists for all legacy settings.
acceptance: Map each setting; preview unsupported values; repeated imports must not overwrite newer preferences.

security.label: Security, privacy and tenant boundaries
security.summary: Cross-cutting checks for every dashboard, connector, worker and external integration.

capabilities.label: Organization and brand isolation
capabilities.current: SaaS requests check organization/brand scope and use separate brand data stores.
acceptance: Attempt cross-tenant reads and writes through routes, jobs, exports and guessed identifiers.

capabilities.label: Session, CSRF and operator boundaries
capabilities.current: Authenticated routes, CSRF protection and operator middleware exist.
acceptance: Reject missing CSRF, expired sessions and customer access to operator endpoints; test both MFA policy modes.

capabilities.label: Encrypted credentials and retained payloads
capabilities.current: Provider and installation secrets are encrypted; full data lifecycle acceptance remains open.
acceptance: Inspect stored secrets and backups; test key rotation and recovery without printing credentials.

capabilities.label: External hosts and SSRF defenses
capabilities.current: Custom providers require safe HTTPS destinations with public address checks.
acceptance: Reject private/reserved destinations, unsafe redirects and credential-bearing URLs; cover IPv4 and IPv6.

capabilities.label: Untrusted content and tool authority
capabilities.current: Cloud ticket workflows use fixed task boundaries; all legacy tools still need cloud permission checks.
acceptance: Treat tickets, websites and model output as data; prompt injection must not widen tool or database permissions.

capabilities.label: Data export, deletion and retention
capabilities.current: A complete tenant export and erasure workflow is not available.
acceptance: Inventory retained data; test deletion, legal retention exceptions and backup expiry; prevent export leakage.

capabilities.label: Rate limits and operational abuse
capabilities.current: Endpoint throttles and credit limits exist; system-wide abuse controls need validation.
acceptance: Bound queue depth, payload size and concurrency; verify overload returns useful errors without double charging.

operations.label: Deployment, reliability and recovery
operations.summary: Operational acceptance for the deployed cloud, database, workers and release process.

capabilities.label: Dokploy deployment and automated checks
capabilities.current: The SaaS branch has a container deployment and automated PHP, database and browser checks.
acceptance: Build from a known commit; verify application, worker and scheduler use the same release.

capabilities.label: Queue and scheduler health
capabilities.current: Worker and scheduler services exist; production failure drills are outstanding.
acceptance: Kill a worker mid-request; recover queued jobs without duplicate provider calls or charges.

capabilities.label: Database and key backup restoration
capabilities.current: A tested production restore has not been recorded.
acceptance: Restore control-plane and brand databases plus required encryption keys into an isolated environment; record recovery time and data loss.

capabilities.label: Payment and usage disaster reconciliation
capabilities.current: End-to-end recovery of all external and local financial state is not accepted.
acceptance: Reconcile invoices, payment events, wallet entries and uncertain AI requests after restoring a backup.

capabilities.label: Concurrent hosts and load testing
capabilities.current: Capacity for the first 3–5 providers has not been measured under realistic load.
acceptance: Exercise concurrent chat, tickets and billing; record latency, queue delay, memory and database contention.

capabilities.label: Error monitoring and actionable alerts
capabilities.current: A complete alert-to-resolution operations flow is not accepted.
acceptance: Trigger a failed job, billing delivery failure, low disk and unavailable provider; route alerts without secrets.

capabilities.label: Application rollback and schema compatibility
capabilities.current: Deploy rollback exists operationally; data compatibility drills are unverified.
acceptance: Roll back one release while preserving wallet journals, queued work and installation credentials.

upgrade.label: Connector distribution and upgrades
upgrade.summary: Only a bounded bridge may be downloaded; proprietary orchestration and secrets stay in SaaS.

capabilities.label: Thin-connector package boundary
capabilities.current: Packaging uses an exact allowlist and rejects proprietary server files.
acceptance: Inspect the ZIP and standalone branch; verify no core logic, private credentials or unrelated files are distributed.

capabilities.label: Signed stable artifacts and integrity
capabilities.current: Signature and hash verification exist; a stable release has not passed acceptance.
acceptance: Verify the signing key, artifact SHA-256 and size; reject tampering and unknown distribution types.

capabilities.label: Signup, purchase and download gates
capabilities.current: Incomplete migration blocks the public launch path; preview artifacts are separate.
acceptance: Try direct signup, checkout and download URLs before and after accepted readiness; preview must never appear as stable.

capabilities.label: Legacy history and configuration import
capabilities.current: Full import of legacy conversations, policies and preferences is not implemented.
acceptance: Dry-run counts and mappings; migrate with ownership preserved and reconcile before enabling cloud features.

capabilities.label: Upgrade, reinstall and retry safety
capabilities.current: Full legacy-to-cloud upgrade acceptance is outstanding.
acceptance: Run install and upgrade twice; preserve custom data and permissions; recover from interruption without duplicate imports.

capabilities.label: Old clients and rollback journal compatibility
capabilities.current: Compatibility across connector and cloud versions remains unverified.
acceptance: Document supported versions; reject incompatible requests clearly and preserve existing rollback evidence.

public_site.label: Public website and commercial launch
public_site.summary: A preview site is available; commercial opening needs verified functionality and operational evidence.

capabilities.label: Home, pricing and installation guidance
capabilities.current: The public site presents preview plans and installation guidance.
acceptance: Verify mobile navigation, links, plan prices and accurate feature descriptions.

capabilities.label: Honest preview and launch messaging
capabilities.current: The site distinguishes preview from stable availability.
acceptance: Blocked actions explain their status and direct existing operators to readiness; do not advertise pending capabilities as available.

capabilities.label: Plan economics and model margins
capabilities.current: Entry-level packs exist; real provider cost and margin acceptance is pending.
acceptance: Compare selected model input/output costs, selling rates, taxes, gateway fees and per-brand budgets.

capabilities.label: Customer terms, privacy and billing policies
capabilities.current: Launch policies and support processes require publication and acceptance.
acceptance: Publish applicable terms, data handling, refunds, retention and support contacts; test customer access to each page.

capabilities.label: Complete onboarding for pilot hosting providers
capabilities.current: The first 3–5 host onboarding journeys are not accepted.
acceptance: Onboard separate organizations with real WHMCS staging installations, paid credits and one complete support workflow; capture issues and evidence.

journeys.label: New hosting provider to first usable brand
steps: Register and verify email.
Create the organization and first brand.
Verify the WHMCS domain and provision its data store.
Install and pair the connector.
Complete an authorized signed request.
failure_checks: Try duplicate signup and an unverified domain.
Reject another organization's brand and a reused pairing token.

journeys.label: Staff member receives and loses scoped access
steps: Add an existing account to the team with a limited role.
Grant one brand as viewer and another as operator.
Switch workspaces and test permitted actions.
Remove the membership and retry the saved links.
failure_checks: Reject owner removal that leaves no owner.
Deny direct POST actions from viewers and stale sessions after revocation.

journeys.label: Customer recovery and session termination
steps: Request a reset for an existing email.
Receive and follow a valid reset link.
Change the password and sign in.
Sign out and retry authenticated routes.
failure_checks: Reject expired and reused tokens.
Check throttling and avoid exposing whether an email exists.

journeys.label: Operator MFA off, on and recovery
steps: Sign into Command Station under the current policy.
Enable the optional MFA requirement from settings.
Verify the enrolled operator's code.
Exercise the documented disable/recovery procedure.
failure_checks: Customers cannot edit the policy.
Wrong, replayed or expired codes must not grant access.

journeys.label: Custom provider to usable priced model
steps: Save a supported driver and custom HTTPS endpoint.
Create an explicit provider model identifier and rates.
Assign it to an active plan.
Run one real request with a small output cap.
Reconcile recorded tokens, provider cost and charged credits.
failure_checks: Reject private endpoints and unsafe redirects.
Exercise authentication, model-not-found, timeout and quota errors without exposing the API key.

journeys.label: Credit purchase to a funded wallet
steps: Select a published pack and optional valid promo.
Create the HostingSpell invoice.
Complete a real supported gateway payment.
Deliver and authenticate the payment event.
Verify one wallet credit and an auditable invoice link.
failure_checks: Replay and reorder delivery; credit once.
Reject invalid signatures and mismatched amounts/currencies; recover a missed event.

journeys.label: Pooled and allocated budgets across brands
steps: Fund the organization wallet.
Run two brands on shared credits with independent monthly limits.
Allocate credits to a third brand.
Run concurrent requests near the limit.
Compare reservations, settled spend and available balance.
failure_checks: Never overspend through concurrency.
Insufficient funds and budget limits must fail before starting chargeable work.

journeys.label: Provider timeout to reconciled charge
steps: Reserve funds and send a provider request.
Interrupt after dispatch so the result is uncertain.
Inspect the reserved request in Command Station.
Check provider evidence and reconcile once.
Verify the wallet and audit trail.
failure_checks: Do not silently retry and charge again.
Reject a second settlement or an unauthorized reconciliation.

journeys.label: Connector key rotation and revocation
steps: Pair a staging WHMCS connector.
Make a valid signed request.
Rotate or revoke installation access.
Re-enroll using the new credentials.
Confirm old signatures and nonces are rejected.
failure_checks: Deny replay, stale timestamp, changed body and wrong installation ID.
Inactive brands and suspended organizations must fail closed.

journeys.label: Ticket context to an accepted AI draft
steps: Open an authorized ticket.
Select model and workflow with bounded context.
Submit analysis, rewrite or scoring.
Wait for the persisted request result.
Review the output before using it in the ticket.
failure_checks: Reject access to a forbidden department or ticket.
Duplicate submissions and timeouts must not create duplicate charges; restore usable controls on errors.

journeys.label: Draft, editor preview and final reply
steps: Generate a structured draft and open its preview.
Preserve formatting, links and the staff signature.
Edit and insert into the WHMCS reply editor.
Send through WHMCS.
Reopen the ticket and confirm history and audit context.
failure_checks: Do not overwrite unsaved editor text.
Escape unsafe HTML and avoid sending a draft automatically.

journeys.label: Ticket update to a scoped case timeline
steps: Enable approved read sources and retention.
Open a ticket and capture a bounded snapshot.
Navigate timeline events to related records.
Run an interpretation with source attribution.
Verify retention cleanup and preserved snapshots.
failure_checks: No writes through read sources.
Missing relations and partial diagnostics must show uncertainty, not invented events.

journeys.label: Visitor widget to grounded answer
steps: Load the embedded widget on the allowed site.
Start a visitor session and ask a hosting question.
Resolve authorized knowledge sources and selected model.
Stream or render a formatted answer.
Reload and resume the same conversation.
failure_checks: Reject untrusted origin/session substitution.
Handle provider outage, disconnection and quota exhaustion with a usable message.

journeys.label: Signed-in client asks about their account
steps: Establish the logged-in client's identity.
Ask about an invoice, service or product.
Return scoped records and usable links.
Follow the links in WHMCS.
Sign out and verify account context is removed.
failure_checks: Never reveal another client's records.
Do not infer account ownership from a name or email in a prompt.

journeys.label: Bot conversation to staff and back
steps: A visitor requests a human.
Alert eligible online staff.
One staff member claims the conversation.
Exchange messages with clear speaker identity.
Release the claim or handle its timeout.
failure_checks: Two staff cannot both own an exclusive claim.
Bot responses stop while staff owns the conversation; reconnect without duplicate alerts.

journeys.label: Conversation to linked support ticket
steps: Request ticket escalation.
Verify contact details and select an allowed department.
Create one ticket with the relevant transcript.
Return its authorized link and confirmation.
Record feedback without changing conversation ownership.
failure_checks: Replay must not create duplicate tickets.
Anonymous visitors cannot open private admin ticket links.

journeys.label: Admin opens related invoices and services from the connector
steps: Enable the lookup for an approved role and open the connector widget.
Find a client by ID, full name or exact company name and choose an account.
Select invoices or services and page through the results.
Render a bounded table with individual record links.
Follow profile, invoice and service links within the configured WHMCS admin path.
failure_checks: Require explicit client selection when duplicate names match.
Handle empty/paginated results and escape HTML; unauthorized rows must never appear.

journeys.label: Role-scoped database query
steps: Enable an explicit role/resource read rule.
Request a bounded SELECT through Copilot.
Apply permitted fields and ownership scope.
Display related records and query provenance.
Record the read operation in the journal.
failure_checks: Deny unapproved tables, fields, joins and raw SQL.
Enforce row caps, timeouts and permissions independently of model output.

journeys.label: Plan, approve and atomically apply a change
steps: Propose an allowed create, update or delete.
Inspect target IDs, before/after values, affected rows and side effects.
Approve the exact immutable plan.
Recheck permissions and row versions inside one transaction.
Commit changes with their rollback snapshot and journal.
failure_checks: Changed data or revoked permissions invalidate approval.
Reject replay and expiry; a failure midway leaves no partial writes.

journeys.label: Failed operation and later rollback conflict
steps: Execute an approved multi-row test change.
Inspect its immutable before/after journal.
Roll back an untouched result and verify all rows restore together.
Modify a row independently and attempt rollback.
Show a conflict with a safe recovery path.
failure_checks: Do not overwrite newer edits.
Do not promise reversal of email, payment, provisioning or other external side effects.

journeys.label: WHMCS client credit adjustment and reversal
steps: Preview a permitted client credit adjustment.
Show balance and credit-ledger effects.
Approve and update both atomically.
Verify resulting balance and provenance.
Roll back only if the recorded state is still current.
failure_checks: Reject negative/invalid amounts and unauthorized actors.
Duplicate approval cannot apply credit twice.

journeys.label: Knowledge source to traceable response
steps: Add a permitted knowledge article or website.
Ingest with bounded fetch and tenant ownership.
Refresh the index.
Ask a related question and inspect citations.
Remove the source and verify it is no longer used.
failure_checks: Block private destinations and malicious page instructions.
Show stale or failed ingestion and avoid cross-brand retrieval.

journeys.label: Eligible ticket to controlled automation
steps: Configure departments, exclusions and limits.
Find an eligible ticket.
Build the approved context and response action.
Recheck ticket state before execution.
Record the resulting draft, note or reply and status.
failure_checks: Do not reply after a human has already responded or the ticket closed.
Disable stops future work; retries must not create duplicate replies.

journeys.label: Diagnostic plan to useful evidence
steps: Choose an authorized target and diagnostic scope.
Review the bounded tool plan.
Validate the final destination in the execution service.
Run checks with time and size limits.
Attach traceable results to the case and stop cleanly.
failure_checks: Revalidate redirects and DNS at the actual destination.
Mark partial, timed-out and cancelled checks accurately; never run arbitrary model-supplied commands.

journeys.label: Server incident to targeted notification
steps: Poll permitted server metrics.
Detect an incident with supporting measurements.
Identify affected services and clients.
Preview and send authorized notifications.
Record resolution and suppress duplicate alerts.
failure_checks: A failed poll is not automatically an outage.
Verify audience selection and do not expose server credentials.

journeys.label: Aggregate metrics to related records
steps: Select brand, period and currency.
Generate the report from complete source data.
Reconcile totals and drill into permitted records.
Export the same filtered data.
Confirm late or missing data is labelled.
failure_checks: Do not mix currencies or tenants.
Repeat aggregation safely and distinguish settled from reserved usage.

journeys.label: Pair mobile and handle a support request
steps: Install a signed supported APK.
Pair a device to the intended brand.
Open a push notification for a ticket or chat.
Perform an authorized reply or takeover.
Revoke the device and retry.
failure_checks: Offline retries cannot duplicate replies.
Switching brands or opening a notification must not bypass permissions.

journeys.label: Existing WHMCS install to thin connector
steps: Back up and inventory the legacy installation.
Dry-run data and setting mappings.
Install the connector and import scoped state.
Verify feature parity and old journals.
Repeat safely and exercise the documented rollback path.
failure_checks: Do not ship core code in the replacement package.
Preserve histories and policy defaults; interruption must not corrupt the installation.

journeys.label: Accepted release to verified download
steps: Complete versioned feature and journey acceptance evidence.
Build the exact connector allowlist.
Sign the stable manifest and verify hashes.
Confirm live configuration and release checks.
Download and install through the customer site.
failure_checks: Reject unsigned/tampered packages and non-connector files.
Environment flags cannot bypass an incomplete feature register.

journeys.label: Production backup to recovered service
steps: Restore databases and required encryption keys into isolation.
Reconnect application, workers and scheduler.
Reconcile payment events and AI requests.
Verify installations and wallet balances.
Record recovery time, data loss and rollback results.
failure_checks: Never replay external side effects blindly.
Missing keys or stale backups must surface before resuming production traffic.

journeys.label: Three hosting providers complete onboarding
steps: Select 3–5 distinct pilot organizations.
Complete purchase, domain verification and connector installation.
Run their agreed support workflows with scoped staff.
Exercise load, failure recovery and escalation to support.
Record acceptance evidence and unresolved launch issues.
failure_checks: A successful demo for one organization is not tenant-isolation acceptance.
Block public launch while required features or journeys remain unverified.

database_resources.label: Client profiles
database_resources.notes: Client data needs explicit read fields; credit is handled by the dedicated ledger operation.

database_resources.label: Invoices
database_resources.notes: Changing a status is not a payment refund or reversal.

database_resources.label: Hosting services
database_resources.notes: Provisioning, suspension and SSO have separate permissions and external effects.

database_resources.label: Products
database_resources.notes: Read-only catalog access; do not expose restricted commercial data.

database_resources.label: Support tickets
database_resources.notes: Apply department and staff access in addition to the resource rule.

database_resources.label: Ticket private notes
database_resources.notes: Private notes remain staff-only; preserve author and ticket ownership.

database_resources.label: Client notes
database_resources.notes: Preserve creator, timestamps and client ownership in snapshots.

database_resources.label: Client credit ledger
database_resources.notes: Balance and ledger entries must change in the same transaction.

database_resources.label: Gateway logs
database_resources.notes: Read only the approved ID/date/gateway/result fields; omit raw payment payloads.

release_sequence.label: Prove the cloud foundation
release_sequence.detail: Configure a provider and priced model; validate real inference, email delivery, payment events, scoped access and credit reconciliation.

release_sequence.label: Move and accept the product workflows
release_sequence.detail: Complete ticket, chat, Copilot, database safety, knowledge, automation, diagnostic, analytics and mobile migration through the thin connector.

release_sequence.label: Exercise failure and upgrade paths
release_sequence.detail: Validate tenant isolation, permissions, transaction rollback, legacy imports, backup restore, worker recovery and realistic concurrent load.

release_sequence.label: Pilot and open the stable release
release_sequence.detail: Capture acceptance evidence from separate hosting providers, publish required policies, sign the connector and confirm every live release check before opening sales.

evidence_requirements: Accepted commit or artifact version and staging environment.
Reviewer, review date and a stable reference to the test result or acceptance record.
Observed outcome for each acceptance criterion, including the denied-access and failure paths.
Redacted logs or screenshots where useful; never store credentials, client transcripts or payment payloads in this register.
